blocks.text: A foldable design, a larger display when you need it, and the flexibility of the iPhone experience – all in one device. Apple’s much-anticipated iPhone Duo introduces a new way to experience iPhone, and Smart makes it easier for you to own it with Smart Postpaid Plans+ 1999 starting at P6,304 per month, with zero-interest credit card installment for up to 24 months with select banks.

From 5G connectivity and flexible payments to exclusive pre-order rewards, below are 18 reasons to get your iPhone Duo with Smart Postpaid, which will be accepting iPhone Duo pre-orders today, Oct. 16, from 8 p.m. to 11:59 p.m. via https://smrt.ph/PreorderTheiPhoneDuo.
1. Experience Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone
The iPhone Duo pairs a 7.6-inch inner display with a 5.4-inch outer display: a compact screen for quick interactions and a larger canvas for apps, content, and everyday tasks.
2. Enjoy Smart’s award-winning network

Power your iPhone Duo with Smart’s nationwide 5G network and enjoy a leveled-up experience while streaming, video calling, gaming, and multitasking across both displays. Ookla® recognized Smart for Best Mobile Video Experience in the Philippines for the first half of 2026, with a Video Score of 72.82.
3. Spread out your device payments
Pay for your iPhone Duo over time: up to 24 months at zero interest with select banks’ credit cards, or up to 36 months for eligible renewing subscribers, charged to your Postpaid bill.
4. Enjoy an open-line device
You can get an open-line iPhone Duo when you order it with a Smart Postpaid Plans+, so you can use a compatible SIM or eSIM on your overseas travels, subject to device and network compatibility.
5. Get UNLI 5G for 12 months
Stream, browse, and download on compatible 5G service for 12 months with Smart Postpaid Plans+ 1999.
6. Enjoy Unli Calls
Stay in touch with family, friends, and colleagues with the plan’s unlimited calls.
7. Send Unli Texts
From quick updates to coordinating plans, unlimited texts keep your conversations going all day.
8. Choose an Unli App bundle that fits your lifestyle

Pick the Unli App bundle under Smart Postpaid Plans+ that matches how you use your phone, whether it’s to Connect via social media apps like TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp; Create via YouTube, Gemini, and a full suite of Google Apps; or Play top games like Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Call of Duty Mobile, Honor of Kings, and Blacknut.
9. Call landlines
Reach offices, businesses, and other landline numbers with the plan’s unlimited landline-call benefit.
10. Get high priority on the Smart network
Smart Postpaid Plans+ includes high network priority so your connection gets served ahead of other users.
11. Get 18GB of FREE Open Access Data
Every successful Smart Postpaid pre-order comes with 18GB of FREE Open Access Data valid for three months, for browsing, messaging, and other online activities.
12. Get a FREE P5,000 Smart Accessories voucher
Receive a FREE P5,000 discount voucher for select Smart Accessories with a successful pre-order.
13. Save 18% on select Digimap accessories
Get 18% off select third-party Digimap accessories through the pre-order offer, so you can outfit your new device for less.
14. Get more value through the LiveSmart App
Explore digital services and perks on the LiveSmart App, such as 5% cashback on bills, among other exclusive offers.
15. Explore AI-powered tools with AI.Smart
Use AI.Smart for brainstorming, writing, research, and productivity.
16. Extend your iPhone experience with Apple Watch
Add an eligible Apple Watch cellular plan to access supported connectivity features even when your iPhone isn’t nearby.
17. Connect Apple devices with Smart Device Link
Smart Device Link lets you connect multiple Apple devices to one Smart Postpaid account for P199 per month, charged to your Postpaid bill.
18. Enjoy the convenience of Apple Pay
On supported devices, Apple Pay lets you make contactless payments at participating merchants using an eligible card.
With these 18 reasons, you have more ways to make the most of your new iPhone Duo with Smart Postpaid. Pre-order now at https://smrt.ph/PreorderTheiPhoneDuo.
